summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Laboratorios Horvath landing. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (health, POST /api/leads whatsapp+email, GET /api/leads sorted desc + persistence, missing-name validation). Frontend: all sections render, header scroll state works, nav anchors scroll, gallery tabs filter (21/7/8/6), lightbox opens/closes, animated counters reach final values (40+, 80°C, 4, 15+), contact form POSTs a lead to /api/leads for both channels and shows form-success, whatsapp channel opens api.whatsapp.com in new tab, mobile menu toggle + close work, zero console errors/warnings.

minor.issue: Originally returned '_id' (Mongo alias) instead of 'id' due to Pydantic v2 alias serialization. Fixed by using validation_alias='_id' + serialization_alias='id' and populate_by_name=True in Lead model.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py Lead model previously exposed Mongo alias '_id' in API response — fixed to serialize as 'id' as expected by clients/contract.
Contact.jsx POSTs lead but silently swallows errors (only console.error). Acceptable for landing lead capture but consider showing a subtle inline warning if backend save fails.
server.py: CORS is added AFTER include_router; works in FastAPI because middleware is registered on app, but conventionally add middleware before including routers for clarity.
Lead list endpoint returns up to 500 records without pagination — fine for MVP but should paginate for growth.
seed_data_creation: A few TEST_-prefixed leads created via API during tests; not cleaned up (no delete endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend server.py Lead model now returns 'id'. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_horvath_api.py. All flows verified end-to-end against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: Pydantic v2 alias behavior: Field(alias='_id') is used for BOTH validation and serialization by default, and FastAPI's response_model dumps with by_alias=True, causing '_id' to be exposed. Fix: split into validation_alias/serialization_alias and enable populate_by_name.
